title: pvFeatureEdges
body:
## pvFeatureEdges

Full native Feature Edges: extracts boundary, feature, non-manifold and (optionally) manifold edges of a polygonal surface as polydata lines, with the same classes and ParaView defaults as featureEdges (boundary, feature and non-manifold on, manifold off, FeatureAngle 30°). It also exposes Coloring, which adds a cell array identifying each edge's class so the classes can be coloured or thresholded separately.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Input must be polydata; extract the surface of volume meshes first.
- Inconsistent normals or duplicate points produce spurious feature or boundary edges; run normals and clean first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FeatureEdges`. Identity: `filters/FeatureEdges`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Feature Edges filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoundaryEdges` | If the value of this property is set to 1, boundary edges will be extracted. Boundary edges are defined as lines cells or edges that are used by only one polygon. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Coloring` | If the value of this property is set to 1, then the extracted edges are assigned a scalar value based on the type of the edge. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FeatureAngle` | The value of this property is used to define a feature edge. If the surface normal between two adjacent triangles is at least as large as this Feature Angle, a feature edge exists. (See the FeatureEdges property.) | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `FeatureEdges` | If the value of this property is set to 1, feature edges will be extracted. Feature edges are defined as edges that are used by two polygons whose dihedral angle is greater than the feature angle. (See the FeatureAngle property.) Toggle whether to extract feature edges. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ManifoldEdges` | If the value of this property is set to 1, manifold edges will be extracted. Manifold edges are defined as edges that are used by exactly two polygons. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NonManifoldEdges` | If the value of this property is set to 1, non-manifold edges will be extracted. Non-manifold edges are defined as edges that are use by three or more polygons. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

}

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFeatureEdges",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
